reason: The user asked for the cheapest in-stock t-shirt and whether the agent could 'snag one' for her. The policy only covers cancelling/modifying pending orders, returning/exchanging delivered orders, modifying the default address, and providing profile/order/product information. There is no tool for placing a new order, so the purchase request cannot be fulfilled as stated. The address update appears to have been completed correctly after authentication and confirmation, and the product lookup is within scope, but the unfulfillable purchase request creates risk of an unsuccessful interaction unless the agent rejects that part or transfers.
